scripts/binary_native_runtime.py

Python · Tier B

Stage isolated private CPython images for Server and Gateway distributions.

Usage

Called by the native builder after installing the private Python prefix.

Inputs

Installed prefix, source snapshot, image destination, component and target.

Side effects

Copies runtime files, removes build tooling, writes isolated search paths and generates Server defaults/manual references using the staged interpreter.

Cleanup

The builder owns and removes staging directories; source inputs are read-only.

@see scripts/native_binary_builder.py

@see scripts/binary_runtime_image.py

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
startup_defaults 23 Not yet documented
stage_runtime 39 Copy a private interpreter into a role-specific image and return its relative path. Reject links escaping the prefix, strip package installers and unrelated platform/UI files, and configure isolated imports without changing the host environment. Server images also receive source-derived defaults and references.
